cohort: The study included 218 very low birth weight infants (birth weight < 1500 g) from multiple centers in Emilia Romagna, Italy, enrolled between March 2018 and October 2019.
finding: Non-hemodynamically significant PDA was associated with a 15-fold higher risk of death compared to no PDA, while hsPDA was linked to a 6-fold higher occurrence of BPD, an 8.7-fold increased risk of severe IVH, and an 18-fold increased risk of severe ROP when combined with systemic hypoperfusion and pulmonary overcirculation.
